title: Comparison through the homotopy quotient
statement:
Let E be an additive functor between abelian categories. Given a left derived cochain functor and its comparison, there is a homotopy-category comparison compatible with the canonical cochain-to-homotopy and homotopy-to-derived factorizations, and it has the corresponding universal left derived property.

Precise formal conclusion with its module-variable context (notation is that of the cited statement dependencies):
```lean
universe a av b bv da db
variable {A : Type a} [Category.{av} A] [Abelian A] [HasDerivedCategory.{da} A]
  {B : Type b} [Category.{bv} B] [Abelian B] [HasDerivedCategory.{db} B]
  (E : A ⥤ B) [E.Additive]
theorem exists_homotopy_leftDerived_comparison
    (T : DerivedCategory A ⥤ DerivedCategory B)
    (εc : DerivedCategory.Q ⋙ T ⟶ E.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ) ⋙ DerivedCategory.Q)
    (hc : T.IsLeftDerivedFunctor εc (HomologicalComplex.quasiIso A (.up ℤ))) :
    ∃ ε : DerivedCategory.Qh ⋙ T ⟶ E.mapHomotopyCategory (.up ℤ) ⋙ DerivedCategory.Qh,
      T.IsLeftDerivedFunctor ε (HomotopyCategory.quasiIso A (.up ℤ)) ∧
        ∀ P : CochainComplex A ℤ,
          ε.app ((HomotopyCategory.quotient A (.up ℤ)).obj P) = εc.app P
```

proof.text: Transport the comparison along the natural factorization through the homotopy quotient. The quotient localization makes its components independent of the chosen cochain representative. The left derived universal property transfers across this localization and its canonical factorization isomorphisms, giving existence and uniqueness of the homotopy comparison.
